summary: Set [[Prototype]] and return a boolean rather than Object.setPrototypeOf's target/throw-on-false behavior.

target.notes: Dispatch through the ECMAScript object/internal-method runtime so Proxy traps, property descriptors, coercion, abrupt completion, and boolean-vs-throw behavior are preserved.

semantics.proxy: setPrototypeOf trap and invariants are observable

caveats: Invalid proto still throws TypeError; only a normal false [[SetPrototypeOf]] result becomes false.
Do not replace this with C# reflection or ordinary property access when JavaScript object-model behavior is observable.
